errors.description: Set consistency: the three collar-stand siblings were shot on different cloth and different underlayers (notch = charcoal over bare skin, peak = navy over a navy shirt, shawl = navy over bare skin) despite a MATCHED SET LOCK in each prompt. This one is the peak member.
errors.expected: identical cloth, underlayer, subject distance and framing across notch/peak/shawl
errors.correction: On any re-shoot, fix one cloth and one underlayer across all three members.

notes: Peak reads correctly: the lapel corner sweeps up and outward into a sharp arrowhead aimed back toward the shoulder, with a narrow V slit between collar point and peak, symmetric on both sides. Unmistakable against the notch and shawl siblings.
